name: Parr
role: Soldier, same rank as Larry (probably PFC)
summary: A soldier who held the same rank as Larry — probably PFC — and was with him at Nha Trang after they landed in-country, during the first two months (about September–October 1964) when the new arrivals had no assignment yet. Photographed laughing beside Ron Tototz in VN-0025.
researchNotes: If Parr arrived on the same movement as Larry (September 1964), passenger manifests or unit morning reports from the arrival period could carry the name. Spelling is as Larry's son typed it; confirm with Larry (Parr / Paar / Parrs) and ask for a first name.
